Interface DecisionModel

All Known Implementing Classes:
JevDecisionModel
public interface DecisionModel
The board's embedded decision-model engine: a JEV1 model that picks one action among the legal ones for a state.

Take the engine from its board once, at startup, with MCU.getDecisionModel(), and begin() it: the build links the JEV1 file named by -Djuno.dm.model into the firmware, so one juno:flash uploads the program and its model together. begin(SdCard, String) loads another JEV1 file from an SD card into PSRAM instead, so a model can change without reflashing. Then evaluate(int[], int[]) as often as needed: evaluation reads the caller-owned state and legal-action buffers and allocates nothing.

  • Method Details

    • begin

      ModelStatus begin()
      Uses the JEV1 model the build linked into the firmware, replacing any model loaded before. A program that calls this method must be built with -Djuno.dm.model=<file>, or the build fails. Returns ModelStatus.OK, or ModelStatus.INVALID_MODEL when the engine refuses the linked file.

    • begin

      ModelStatus begin(SdCard card, String path)
      Loads the JEV1 file at path on card, which must already be mounted with its own SdCard.begin(), into PSRAM, replacing any model loaded before. The file is copied through a 1 KiB buffer, so call it once, at startup; it needs a board with PSRAM. Returns ModelStatus.OK, ModelStatus.UNREADABLE for a missing or unreadable file, ModelStatus.EXHAUSTED when PSRAM has no room for it, or ModelStatus.INVALID_MODEL when the engine refuses it.

    • isLoaded

      boolean isLoaded()
      Whether a model is loaded.

    • actions

      int actions()
      The loaded model's number of actions, or 0.

    • features

      int features()
      The loaded model's number of state features, which is the length evaluate(int[], int[]) expects, or 0.

    • evaluate

      int evaluate(int[] state, int[] legalActions)
      Returns the selected action from legalActions for state, or -1 when no model is loaded, the state does not have features() entries or no legal action is one of the model's.

      The buffers are read-only to the engine and remain owned by the caller.

    • release

      void release()
      Unloads the model and frees its PSRAM; isLoaded() is false afterwards.
